pages.library: Simulink Support Package for Raspberry Pi Hardware

fm.title: Sublibraries
fm.description: Domain sublibraries of Raspberry Pi hardware blocks (8 blocks)

rows.intent: Sublibrary of Raspberry Pi audio and video I/O blocks (ALSA audio, camera capture, display) — open to pick a specific media block.
Sublibrary of core Raspberry Pi hardware blocks (digital I/O, LED, GPIO) — open to pick a specific device block.
Sublibrary of Raspberry Pi serial/bus communication blocks (I2C, SPI, UART, CAN) — open to pick a specific interface block.
Sublibrary of Raspberry Pi IoT connectivity blocks (MQTT, ThingSpeak) — open to pick a specific cloud/messaging block.
Sublibrary of Raspberry Pi network communication blocks (TCP/IP, UDP) — open to pick a specific networking block.
Sublibrary of blocks for the Sense HAT add-on board (LED matrix, joystick, environmental sensors).
Sublibrary of Raspberry Pi sensor blocks — open to pick a specific sensor input block.
Sublibrary of Raspberry Pi helper and utility blocks.
